name: Wooden Key
summary: In northern Ashenvale, the Wooden Key rests in the hands of maddened ancients near Felwood’s border. It opens a concealed chest with a remnant of Dartol's Rod.

sections.title: A Key in Mad Hands
sections.body: Crazed and Withered Ancients carry the Wooden Key along the shaded trails north of Raynewood Retreat. Shael'dryn once knew the local treants, but now says corruption has twisted their nature. One carries the key to a chest holding a piece of Dartol's Rod.

sections.title: Unlocking the Rod
sections.body: Shael'dryn sends adventurers to retrieve the key and open a hidden, worn chest in a small glade west of the Felwood road. The Iron Shaft lies inside, one of the components needed to rebuild Dartol's Rod and fight the corruption poisoning the sacred forests.

faq.q: What does the Wooden Key unlock?
faq.answer: The Wooden Key opens a worn chest in a small glade west of the main road heading north into Felwood. Inside lies the Iron Shaft, a piece needed to rebuild Dartol's Rod.
Crazed Ancients and Withered Ancients carry the key through the woods north of Raynewood Retreat, near the Felwood border.

faq.q: Why do the ancients have this key?
aliases: why do treants have the key
faq.answer: Shael'dryn says one of the corrupted treants near Felwood carries the key. She does not explain how it came into the treant's possession.

faq.q: Who sends you to retrieve the Wooden Key?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn, a dryad tending the Moonwell of Purity in Ashenvale, directs adventurers to recover the key as part of the effort to rebuild Dartol's Rod.

angles.text: For any child of the stars, seeing Kalimdor's beloved ancients driven mad and clutching lost relics along the Felwood road is sorrowful.
The twisted ancients holding this key reflect how far the demonic blight has reached into the Cenarion groves between Ashenvale and Felwood.
